title: Small Brass Case Missing from Quay Road
summary: The owner seeks a plain instrument case, not its contents.
author: Notices Desk
paragraphs: A small brass instrument case was lost between the North Quay tram stop and the public reading room on Wednesday evening. Its lid bears a scratched numeral seven beside a maker's mark almost worn away.
The owner asks that the case be returned unopened to the reading-room attendant. A modest reward will be paid upon identification; no account of the contents is required.
